title: Page 72
transc:
SH Beckwith  Washington D. C. May 16th 1864 930 PM 
Hang Rosalie Job Knapp For Crowd Tulip There is
consider able dis = at = is = fact = ion Shylock Pagan
& Pekin Webbs sent pack as Sugar Pike Especially
Shylock latter yacht I respectfully recommend that they be
put in old Palmettos & Queens Shylock Sexton yard
Allen singular retrench will remove all dis = at = is
fact = ion and if not it will do no
harm there Stick Flora still singular Yawl comet gone


S. H. Beckwith 11 PM  Wash DC May 16 1864 ----
Hunter Job Marshall Sarah For Chart tulip Negus has
anticipated your repeats and swindles wherry on his return
to Peru talbot advent yard all the silvers we
can collect will be put Shylock hands of Veteran
pedlar summer and sent to Persia talbot Argus Stick
I have sent the substance of your despatch to
Neptune yacht Instead of patenting on Stanton he is
already in full Vulture on Straus burg tulip if
you expect any thing from him you will be
miss taken yard he will do nothing but run
yacht he never did any thing else stick The
costume proposes to put Meridan in his place stick
send him up immy tulip pilots at chapel carried
away pike I have sent udders wherry to replace
